injuries.description: was diagnosed to suffer sprain injury of left thigh.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Stopped practising bodybuilding exercises and jogging in gymnasium and he also participated in bodybuilding competitions. After his injury, he stopped practising those exercises that he used to do and he does stretching exercises instead.
He cannot walk for a long period of time. He can climb stairs but slowly. He cannot fully squat.
